By.description:
Who decides that a task follows an edge: `code`, a `model`, a `human`, or nobody while it is
`asleep` on a wait.

Debate.description:
A debate step's `debate` table: two agents, in speaking order, the rounds after their
openings, and the most the debate may cost.

agents.description: Exactly two different agents, in speaking order.

cap.description: The most the debate may cost, such as `$3.00`, priced from `prices.toml`.

rounds.description: How many rounds follow the opening, 1 to 5.

Decider.description: Who decides a step's outcome: a `code` action, a `model` run or a `human`.

Effect.description: What a step may change: `none`, `read`, `reversible` or `irreversible`.

GuardAllow.description: A workflow's or a step's `guard` table.

allow.description: Guard names, built-in or from `[guard]` in `factory.toml`.

PlanField.description: A field a plan result carries beside its summary.

oneOf.description: How the change is tested: the method, not the checks.
The commands or checks that prove the change.

Proof.description: A check the daemon makes before it accepts a model step's outcome.

oneOf.description: The factory's gate passed at the task's head, run by `priory gate`.

Step.description: One step: who decides its outcome, what it may change, and where each outcome leads.

action.description:
The built-in action a code step runs: `open-pr`, `open-issue`, `open-memories-pr`, `run` or
`start-batch`.

after.description: What the task waits for before it enters the step: `merged`, every pull request it owns.

agent.description: The agent that runs a model step.

approves.description: The irreversible steps a human step approves.

attach.description:
Model steps only: whether each new run of the step runs the factory's `[runs] attach`
command, which opens the run where a person can watch it.

autonomous.description: Why an irreversible step may run without a person's approval.

budget.description:
Model steps only: the dollars the task may spend at this step, such as `"1.00"`, priced
with `prices.toml` at each turn end.

by.description: Who decides an outcome's edge, where it differs from the step's decider.

command.description: The command a human step's answer runs, as an ask's `command`.

debate.description:
Two agents who debate the model step's question for a fixed number of rounds, in place of
its `agent`.

gate.description:
The scorers that grade an outcome before the daemon accepts it, by outcome. A failing one
refuses the outcome; none can approve anything.

guard.description: The guarded calls an irreversible step may make while it is approved or autonomous.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the workflow; `done` and `stop` are reserved.

next.description: Each outcome and the step it leads to, or `done` or `stop`.

options.description: The answers a person picks from at a human step.

plan_requires.description: The fields of a plan result that this model step's prompt or agent must ask for.

prompt.description: What a model step tells its agent.

proof.description: What the daemon checks before it accepts an outcome, by outcome.

question.description:
What a human step's ask says, the step's id when unset. It may name fields of the task's
event, as `{pull_request}`.

record.description:
Model steps only: the factory's command that records evidence after the step's result, in a
checkout of the result's commit, relative to the factory folder.

run.description: The command a `run` action runs with `sh -c`.

timeout.description:
How long one turn of a model step, a `run` action's command, or the command a human step's
answer runs, may run before Priory ends it.

StepAfter.description: What a step waits for before the task enters it.

oneOf.description: Every pull request of the task's stack merged.

StepCommand.description:
The command a human step's answer runs once: `argv` exec'd in `target`, on the options in
`runs`.

argv.description: The program and its arguments, never parsed by a shell.

runs.description: The options whose answer runs it.

target.description: `worktree`, the task's worktree, or a name in `[asks.targets]`; `worktree` when unset.

description:
`workflows/<name>.toml` or `.yaml`: the typed steps a task goes through. The file name is the
workflow's name.

band.description: The band of its tasks when neither their request nor their trigger sets one.

guard.description: The guarded calls every step of the workflow may make with no approval.

max_prs.description:
The most pull requests a task's stack may hold: `open-pr` refuses a longer one. No cap
when unset.

reopen.description:
The model step a done task goes back to when its open pull request gets feedback; by
default, the step that opened the pull request.

sandbox.description:
The sandbox of `factory.toml` that every model step of the workflow runs its agent in.
None runs agents with the person's whole user, as before.

start.description: The id of the first step.

title: workflow
